notes.title: I am back for regular weekly updates!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First off, I want to wish you all a joyful and relaxing holiday season. Thank you for your patience these past couple of months while I focused on something new. I’m excited to share that I’ve been hard at work on my other game, The Righteous Scar, which is now under review for release!

With that stage reached, I’m back to Castle of Lord Velimir, with regular updates to make it better. I deeply appreciate your support and invite you to check out The Righteous Scar—a project I believe surpasses Lord Velimir in almost every way.

In this update:
-Fix - Unwanted attack buffering/stuck in combo
-Fix - Enemy flying attack
-New area
-New shortcut
-small fixes

Stay tuned for updates, and happy gaming!

Cheers,
GM

notes.title: Celebrate the Upcoming Release of The Righteous Scar!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!

I’ve been hard at work preparing my next game, The Righteous Scar, which is now very close to release! To celebrate this exciting milestone, I’m offering a special discount on my first game, COLV.

After the release of The Righteous Scar, I’ll be dedicating time to updating both games regularly. Over the next few months, you can look forward to fresh content and improvements for both The Righteous Scar and COLV.

Thank you so much for your continued support—it means the world to me! Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: New game, updates, and promise about microtransactions
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Once again, my deepest gratitude to all of you who have supported me and played Castle of Lord Velimir. Your feedback, encouragement, and honest reviews have been invaluable, and I am truly thankful for this community. The journey has been a wild one, and I know COLV wasn't perfect at launch. But rest assured, I'll keep pushing regular updates until most of us can say, "Good! This is the game it was meant to be."

Now, I’m thrilled to announce that I’m hard at work on my next game, The Righteous Scar, a revenge-driven action experience that I can’t wait to share with you. I'm aiming to release it this November, and I promise it will deliver a powerful story with intense gameplay.

Lastly, a quick note on a value I hold dear: there will be no in-game purchases or microtransactions in my games—ever. I believe in creating complete experiences without asking for more from you beyond the initial purchase. You deserve it, and I wouldn’t have it any other way.

Thanks again for being on this journey with me. I hope you’ll continue to enjoy what’s coming!

With gratitude,
Goran

notes.title: Update Announcement for "Castle of Lord Velimir"
notes.content:
Dear players,

First and foremost, I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to everyone who purchased "Castle of Lord Velimir" during its first month of release. I know the game was not as polished as it should have been, and some parts were even incomplete. I deeply regret that I couldn’t postpone the release or fully finish the game on time, and I sincerely apologize for that.

However, I’m excited to announce that I’m finally able to focus on completing and polishing the game. Today, I’ve rolled out a small update, and moving forward, you can expect weekly updates as I try to improve the experience. I’ll be closely following your reviews and feedback to make sure we shape this game into something truly great—together.

Thank you again for your patience and support. I’m committed to making "Castle of Lord Velimir" everything it deserves to be.

Best,
Goran
